description: Basal aerobic growth on glucose minimal media: biomass yield Yxs (gDW per g glucose). Measured values are the grade target; theoretical_max rows are first-principles ceilings.
Basal aerobic exponential growth rate mu (1/h) on glucose minimal media.
Basal aerobic specific glucose uptake rate q_glc (mmol/gDW/h) on glucose minimal media. With growth_rate and biomass_yield, two of these three are independent (Yxs = mu / (q_glc * M_glc)).

Basal aerobic central-carbon intracellular reaction fluxes (per-reaction vector, 13C-MFA). Each row carries absolute value and value_relative_pct (normalized to glucose uptake). One row per (source, reaction, timepoint).
Basal aerobic specific oxygen uptake rate (OUR, mmol/gDW/h) on glucose minimal media.
Basal aerobic specific CO2 evolution rate (CER, mmol/gDW/h) on glucose minimal media; with o2_uptake gives the respiratory quotient RQ = CER/OUR.
Basal aerobic acetate secretion rate (mmol/gDW/h) on glucose minimal media; the overflow-metabolism axis.
Basal aerobic proteome on glucose minimal media: per-gene absolute protein abundance (copies/cell, vector). One row per (source, gene).

Basal absolute intracellular metabolite concentrations (mol/L, per-metabolite vector) across glucose/glycerol/acetate carbon sources, with 95% CIs. One row per (source, metabolite, condition). The basal card uses the glucose rows.

Basal macromolecular dry-mass composition (protein/RNA/DNA as fraction of dry weight, per-component vector) vs growth rate. One row per (source, component, doubling_time). Grade against the row matching the model's growth rate.

Aerobic acetate-overflow response: acetate excretion (mM/OD600/h) vs growth rate across glucose/lactose uptake titrations, glycerol uptake mutants, and a carbon-source panel (Basan 2015, strain NCM3722). One row per (source, series, level); the overflow card grades the uptake_titration/ptsG_glucose series with the curve_response criterion (onset + slope).
